name: managing-anticoagulation-therapy
description: Reviews one patient's anticoagulation and drafts findings for the prescriber and pharmacist; never writes orders. Checks DOAC eligibility (mechanical valve, moderate to severe mitral stenosis, triple-positive APS) and dose against FDA labels for apixaban, rivaroxaban, dabigatran and edoxaban: apixaban two-of-three reduction (age, weight, creatinine), Cockcroft-Gault CrCl on the right weight, not eGFR, P-gp and CYP3A4 interactions, enoxaparin at CrCl below 30, feeding-tube use. Reads warfarin INR trends against the dose log. Builds periprocedural interruption and resumption timelines per CHEST 2022, PAUSE and BRIDGE, each element on its own clock; flags bridging without a high-risk reason. Checks transitions for duplicate anticoagulants and switch rules; reviews reversal (idarucizumab, 4F-PCC, andexanet alfa's end of U.S. sales) and Joint Commission NPG.14.04.01. Use for DOAC or enoxaparin dosing review, warfarin monitoring, periop anticoagulation, bridging, reversal or anticoagulation protocol review.
